payload.big_idea:
INHERITS se.vision - no deviation, so the axiom is not re-derived (state-inheritance).

THE i12 DELTA IN ONE BREATH: today the machine ASKS THE AGENT TO VOUCH FOR ITS OWN WORK, and gives it tools poor enough that the honest path runs outside the lane. i12 inverts both - the machine computes what can be computed and hands the agent every rule that applies, while the lane becomes good enough that reaching outside it stops being tempting.

LINEAGE: this is not a new idea, it is the demand signal finally being served. The engine has always treated a logged se_help miss as recorded demand for a tool that does not exist - and that loop has WORKED, repeatedly: a missing run lane produced se_run, a missing note lane produced se_note, missing canvas ops produced them. Exactly one category was never picked up, and it is the one the agent uses most: reading and searching. i12 is that backlog, plus the structural consequence the owner named - that the way to trust an agent-blessed gate is to compute more of it, never to watch it harder.
payload.to_be_world:
A SESSION OPENS. The agent asks for its next step and the packet arrives carrying not one hand-written paragraph but every rule that applies to this state - the laws, the methods, the guidance, resolved rather than linked. The agent does not have to have been present when a law was minted to be bound by it.

IT NEEDS THE DESIGN DOCUMENT. It reads pages 40 through 60 of a 132k-character file in one call. It needs to know what v1 did: it searches @v1 by name, and the log records that it consulted v1's checklist - not that some path on some disk was opened. It needs to know what a previous iteration decided: it searches the RECORD, across every iter/* tag, and finds evidence that was deliberately withheld from the working tree.

IT MAKES SIX EDITS TO SIX FILES. One call, atomic, each hash-guarded. It does not write a sweep script, because the sweep script would be slower.

IT REACHES A GATE. The evidence form asks for judgement and nothing else, because everything computable has already been computed: the lint has compared what the build touched against what the architecture allocated, confirmed the tests ran red before they ran green, and checked that every requirement names a verify method and a breaks-if-removed. The agent's prose covers what only prose can cover. When it self-blesses under the owner's standing grant, what it is vouching for is small enough to vouch for honestly.

AND THE OWNER, WHO WAS NOT THERE, CAN AUDIT IT: every computed check is distinguishable from every asserted one, because they carry their own evidence rather than the agent's word.
payload.goal_system:
G1 THE LANE IS THE PATH OF LEAST RESISTANCE. Not 'the lane is mandatory' - mandatory loses to a fence hole. The tools must be better than the alternatives, so the agent uses them for the same reason it would use anything: they win.

G2 WHAT CAN BE COMPUTED IS COMPUTED. Every check the machine currently asks the agent to assert about its own work moves to a lint where a lint can carry it.

G3 EVERY RULE REACHES THE AGENT THAT IT BINDS. A law with an applies_to must arrive in the packet, not wait to be discovered.

G4 THE RECORD SURVIVES CARELESSNESS. A deleted tag, a push without a flag, a clone on another machine - none of these may lose the evidence.

CONFLICTS, NAMED OPENLY:

G1 vs G2 - SPEED VERSUS FRICTION. Every lint is a new way for the machine to say no. The whole point of G1 is to stop the lane feeling like an obstacle, and G2 adds obstacles. RULED: they only conflict if the lints are wrong. A lint that refuses correctly REPLACES an agent's paragraph of self-justification - it is less work, not more. A lint that refuses incorrectly is a defect to fix, never a cost to accept. Any lint that fires wrongly gets removed rather than worked around.

G1 vs G3 - MORE GUIDANCE IS MORE TO READ. Joining every applicable rule into every packet risks burying the step's actual instruction under a wall of law. RULED: relevance is the mechanism, not volume - applies_to must be narrow enough that a packet carries the rules that bind THIS state, and a rule that applies to everything belongs in the contract, not in a join.

G2 vs THE OWNER'S AUTONOMY GOAL - a lint that cannot decide could block an unattended run at 3am. RULED, and this is se.law-responsibility-never-delegates in force: a lint either decides or defers to judgement; it never parks. Blocking an unattended run to ask a question the machine could not answer is the failure mode, not the safety feature.

PRIORITY ORDER, ruled: G2 over G1 where they truly conflict - a slower correct machine beats a fast one that reports green wrongly, and this whole iteration exists because green was reported wrongly for two days. G3 before G1, because a fast agent that does not know the rules is worse than a slow one that does. G4 is independent and cheap; it loses to nothing.
payload.moore_pitch:
FOR the agent walking the loop and the owner who must own its output,
WHO need the lane to be worth using and its gates worth trusting,
THE tool surface and the machine's own checks
ARE a working environment - reads that reach anywhere by name, searches that see both the tree and the record, batched edits, and lints that judge the mechanical half of every gate,
THAT lets the agent stay inside the lane because it is the fastest way to work, and lets a self-blessed killer rest on computation rather than on the agent's attention,
UNLIKE today, where the lane cannot open the two documents the process REQUIRES the agent to consult, the most-used tool applies one edit per call, four laws minted this afternoon will never reach a packet, and every gate asks the agent to vouch for its own conformance in prose.
